A total of 35 unique BCTs were used across the dialogues
We used 4 complementary feature selection methods
only BCTs selected by at least 3 of the 4 models were retained for subsequent analysis
we consistently identified 3 BCTs that were most predictive

biochemically validated tobacco abstinence at 6 months after randomization
key secondary outcome was 3-month (end of treatment) validated abstinence
